# Requirements Quality Checklist: Mushaf Reader, Wirds and Reminders

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of feature 001: is the spec complete, clear, consistent and
measurable on Mushaf data integrity, position and portion rules, and reminders, before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-11-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the behaviour specified when bundled Mushaf data for a page is missing or unreadable at run time (not only at build time)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is what the reader shows while a page's font is not yet available defined (placeholder, blank, wait)? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, SC-007]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are validation rules for wird form fields defined (empty or duplicate name, pages per day < 1, target date before today, start page outside 1–604)? [Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the effect of editing a wird's goal or start page in the middle of a day on today's fixed portion specified in the spec (it appears only in research R7)? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the bookmark behaviour defined when no wird exists or the reader is in browse mode? [Gap, Spec §FR-033, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the order of the bookmark list (per wird vs all together, sort order) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-033]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is it specified what a wird notification shows or opens if its wird was deleted after scheduling? [Gap, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are user-facing messages for a rejected import and a failed or cancelled export given in Arabic? [Gap, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the light/dark appearance requirement stated, or explicitly left to the implementer? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are accessibility needs (system text size, screen reader for bars and panel) stated or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Constitution VI]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 - Is the top-bar hizb format («جزء N · حزب N» plus the quarter) written out exactly, including how the quarter appears? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is it clear whether "hizb" in the top bar is numbered 1–60 while the stored quarter runs 1–240? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, data-model]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "the first remaining wird" defined by a stated order (list order, creation date)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "the day's portion is first needed" defined by concrete triggers (app open, panel shown, reminder planning)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-028]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "paged past page B" defined precisely enough to say whether paging in browse mode counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-030, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the reminder scheduling window (14 days, refreshed on app open) stated in the spec rather than as a vague "limited window"? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, FR-037]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the body «من ص A إلى ص B» defined for reminders on future days, when that day's portion does not exist yet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "a mid-range phone" in SC-007 defined so that the 300 ms target can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the wird colour choice specified (free picker or fixed palette, how many colours)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, FR-027]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 - Is FR-033 ("bookmark for the active wird") consistent with the Bookmark entity's optional wird and the Assumption about deleted wirds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-033, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are reminder defaults per type consistent between FR-025, US2 scenario 2 and the first-launch defaults in FR-024? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, FR-025]
- [ ] CHK022 - Do FR-030 (done when paged past B) and FR-031 («تم» moves the position only if behind) agree on the khatma case at page 604, where paging past B is impossible? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030, FR-031]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are the reference values (604 pages, 8/15 lines, 83,668 words, 6,236 ayahs, 114 surahs, al-Kahf 293, 2:255 on 42) stated identically in the spec, the constitution and contracts/assets.md? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is the al-Kahf notification's target (page 293, browse mode) consistent between FR-036, US3 and contracts/notifications.md? [Consistency, Spec §FR-036]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK025 - Can "every word exactly once and in order" (SC-002) be checked objectively against a stated source of truth? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, FR-002]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is "no overflow, every word visible" defined measurably for the two reference screen sizes? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the "under 1 minute" target in SC-003 justified or marked as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is "same line height as a 15-line page, vertically centred" for pages 1–2 testable without subjective judgement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 - Are day rollover requirements stated for each case: app open across midnight, app closed, phone timezone changed forward and back? [Coverage, Spec §FR-029, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the qiyam day boundary (portion read after midnight) decided in the spec rather than left as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for a target date today, in the past, and exactly at the last page (current page 604)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are recovery requirements defined if the app is closed in the middle of an import (data must be either old or new, never mixed)? [Recovery, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is behaviour defined when notification permission is denied and later granted (reminders scheduled from then on)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are requirements defined for a notification tapped while the app is already open on another wird or in browse mode? [Coverage, Spec §FR-035, FR-036]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK035 - Is the licence status of each bundled resource recorded as a requirement with the owner's decision (FR-042), including the condition for publishing beyond the private APK? [Dependency, Spec §FR-042, Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the dependency on the 1421H edition's layout data stated as the only source of page and line numbers, so other data (e.g. Tanzil page numbers) is excluded? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001, research R4]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are the designer defaults (20 pages/day, 20:00, 09:00, reminder on/off by type, position rules) all marked as changeable in one place? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items (CHK004, CHK005, CHK011, CHK016, CHK019, CHK030) have a default already chosen in research.md R7; resolving them means moving that decision into the spec (e.g. via `/speckit-clarify`) or accepting the default
